title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Batik Cap. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Batik Cap
options.lineage: Indonesian batik cap — carved stamps, wax resist, indigo and sogan
options.thesis: The bill is a printed cloth: every mark on it was stamped, and what is not yet stamped is still wax.
options.viewport: A head-of-cloth band carries the outstanding total; below it the table stamps down the lanes, one printed row per person, and the tool rail sits at the cloth's foot.
options.risk: Pattern without a task is costume — if the stamps do not carry every state, the world is wallpaper.

raised.raise: A tonal arc: the balance sits in the deepest ink and the cloth lightens as bills settle; state is always lettered, never carried by light alone.
One pull per surface: exactly one decisive primary control (Simpan, Bagikan nota, Tandai semua), never a row of equal buttons.
Amounts are display type: tabular, integer-scaled, never shrunk to caption size.
Machine codes get a plate: ref codes, tokens, and account numbers are set as stencilled plates, and destructive actions carry a hazard tick.

options.label: Buku Kas
options.thesis: The app is the cash book: ruled columns that have to add up, and a red pen for what is settled.
options.viewport: One ruled page: name and amount columns, the total under a double rule, red ticks in the margin.
options.risk: It is the answer most runs would reach — a ruled ledger is the first thing anyone would draw, and only craft separates it.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The app is a broadcast index: every bill is a numbered page, every state a REVEAL away.
options.viewport: A page header counts the balance as top story; bills are an index you key into, and REVEAL answers a proof.
options.risk: Reads retro-novelty when the grid is not strict, and a fixed 40-cell row fights long Indonesian names.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — bills and proofs become numbered pages with REVEAL holding the verdict — but loses on identification: nobody's group chat is a teletext.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every share is a lane tied to its default by a link line whose shape — not colour — says what state it is in.
options.viewport: An overview strip sits over a lane grid; every share's state is a drawn tie line, unbroken, ticked, gapped, or open-ended.
options.risk: A machine-room aesthetic is nobody's group chat; the state grammar must survive translation or it is cosplay.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — one drawn link state per share, no colour carrying meaning — but loses on identification and on phone density.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: stage lighting cyclorama, night into day
options.thesis: The ledger is a stage at dawn: the bill darkens while it is owed and lightens as it resolves.
options.viewport: Horizon bands stacked dark to light, the balance riding the cobalt line.
options.risk: Atmosphere has no column for money; the arc must be lettered or it implies state by light.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a stage technician's world, and money needs a column, not a cue.
options.kept: A tonal progression the direction will letter, never colour alone.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: silk cape gathered by one hidden cord
options.thesis: One pull gathers the flat bill into shares; one release settles it.
options.viewport: A flat plane of the bill, one gold cord, gathered rib rows beneath.
options.risk: A fashionable gesture in a task UI is decoration unless the pull is the primary action.
options.case: Fuses poorly: couture is not this audience's world, and the transformation explains nothing about money.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.lineage: bitmap type specimens at poster scale
options.thesis: Money set at specimen scale: the amount is the headline, in whole-pixel type.
options.viewport: The outstanding figure at poster scale over a grid of bill rows.
options.risk: Specimen type is a designer's nostalgia; bitmap money must stay perfectly legible at 390px.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an art-school world, and the specimen says nothing about who owes whom.
options.kept: Amounts as display type at integer scale.

options.label: Starship Crew Terminal
options.thesis: The bill as ship's paperwork: stencilled codes, typed readouts, hazard plates on anything destructive.
options.viewport: A typed readout over stencilled plates, hazard pictograms on the destructive row.
options.risk: The sci-fi frame is a costume; only the plate discipline is worth keeping.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody's dinner bill is a starship log, and a typewriter reveal slows an operator down.
options.kept: A plate vocabulary for machine codes and destructive actions.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fintech split-bill dashboard, executed impeccably: balance card, bill list, blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects — balance, list, tab bar — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
